claims.claim: For finite root-conditioned laws the population CGF is logsumexp of conditional CGFs and its Hessian exactly decomposes into within-root covariance plus between-root tilted mean covariance. Geometry mixture and intrinsic fluctuation must be distinguished.
claims.limit: Exact mathematical identity and 261 authenticated empirical source cases; between-root fractions depend on coordinates, sampled population and tilt, no physical criticality or universal scale.

claims.claim: For the registered finite B128 clean evaluator laws, the H32 root+history conditioned weighted suffix forecast has lower proper joint energy score than both transported unconditional suffix and root-only kernel in all six external family-cohort cells; regular root CGF errors also smaller. Exact prefix count/mark bounds and joint donor dependence retained.
claims.limit: Two specific external cohorts, 24/32 geometry blocks; not a universal population guarantee, not pre-search prediction or autonomous closure. Root-only gate fails 1/6; history-only can be better than root+history; limited tail ESS and high absolute W error.
